title: Supply Chain Bottlenecks
scenario: Identify products where cumulative demand has exceeded total warehouse capacity.
tableSchema: inventory (prod_id INT, demand INT, capacity INT, arrival_date DATE)
correctQuery: SELECT prod_id, arrival_date FROM (SELECT prod_id, arrival_date, SUM(demand) OVER(PARTITION BY prod_id ORDER BY arrival_date) as cum_demand, capacity FROM inventory) t WHERE cum_demand > capacity;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE inventory (prod_id INT, demand INT, capacity INT, arrival_date DATE);
